seo_title: YMCA Singapore Case Study: Content Distribution | SOMIN
description: Fyreflyz used SOMIN to read 416 posts from YMCA of Singapore and six peers: the same story earned 54 engagements on Instagram and 1 on Facebook.
eyebrow: Agency case study · Youth charity · Singapore
h1: YMCA does not have a storytelling problem, it has a distribution problem
lede: Fyreflyz used SOMIN to read 416 posts from YMCA of Singapore and six peer organisations over 90 days, plus 12 months of paid-ads data. The read found the same story earning 54 engagements on Instagram and 1 on Facebook, and no paid ads run by YMCA or anyone in the category. It produced three territories, 21 propositions, a 13-week calendar and 54 creatives.
meta_line: A SOMIN agency pitch · 22 May to 20 Aug 2026 · Singapore

challenge.title: YMCA's 18.8% share of category content earns 18.0% of engagement
challenge.body: YMCA of Singapore publishes more than almost anyone in its category: 18.8% of category content, converted into 18.0% of engagement. SHINE Children & Youth Services publishes 77 posts to YMCA's 78 and earns 49% more engagement. The pitch had to show where the return was leaking before asking for budget.

approach.title: 80 YMCA posts against 407 from six peers, plus a paid-ads check
points: Read YMCA's own posts (n=80) against six peer organisations (n=407) in one SOMIN workspace, 22 May to 20 Aug 2026.
Audited 50 recent YMCA posts by channel, format, tone and audience framing, using medians so one 383-engagement outlier could not distort the picture.
Checked SOMIN's paid-ads index for the trailing 12 months across all seven organisations.
Tracked four monthly trend windows and mapped the territory YMCA occupies against the ground the category publishes on and YMCA does not.
Built three insight territories from SOMIN personas, tensions and stories, then generated propositions, moment triggers and creatives.

findings_title: Where YMCA's engagement leaks: channel, guests and territory

findings.title: Same story, 54x apart
findings.body: A vocational-training story earned 54 engagements on Instagram and 1 on Facebook on the same day. Facebook takes 30% of YMCA's output and returns a median of 3, against 19 on Instagram.

findings.title: The best post was a guest's
findings.body: The quarter's top post, at 383 engagements, was published by a guest about a YMCA event. YMCA's own post on the same event earned 0.

findings.title: The strongest territory is under-used
findings.body: Impact You Can See returns 27.45 engagements per post against a 19.7 average, yet holds only 29 of 80 posts (36%). Inclusion is 41% of output and the least-returning of the three territories, at 17.12.

delivered.title: Three territories, 21 propositions and 54 creatives for YMCA
points: Three insight territories, each with a named activation: Impact You Can See, Everyday Good and Champions of Inclusion
21 SOMIN propositions on the YMCA product, five shown in full
A 13-week calendar of 40 dated slots at three posts a week, each mapped to a SOMIN moment trigger
A first paid-funnel media split with illustrative S$30,000, S$60,000 and S$120,000 tiers
54 creative expressions across three pillars and three funnel stages

quote.text: Nothing about the story was wrong. The distribution was.

outcome.title: YMCA should fix distribution before making more content
outcome.body: The first moves need no budget: halve Facebook organic output, set up a retargeting pixel and donor-nurture audiences, and brief the guests who already post about YMCA. The pitch projects engagement per organic post rising from 19.7 to 26.0 over 13 weeks, stated as a projection, not a result.

faq.q: What data did SOMIN use for the YMCA pitch?
faq.a: Published posts from YMCA of Singapore and six peer organisations between 22 May and 20 Aug 2026, plus SOMIN's paid-ads index for the trailing 12 months. It measures published content and public engagement, not audience research or donation data.

faq.q: Why does the pitch cut Facebook instead of adding content?
faq.a: Identical stories earned 54 engagements on Instagram and 1 on Facebook, and Facebook's median is 3 per post. The pitch moves that effort to Instagram and keeps Facebook as a paid distribution surface only.

faq.q: Are the targets in the pitch guaranteed?
faq.a: No. The deck labels them projections built from in-category benchmarks and YMCA's own baselines. It also flags that the SOMIN corpus starts on 21 Apr 2026, so trends are single-cycle and unverified.
